interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity or OpenCode for an independent opinion, review or debate
interface.longDescription: Runs a fresh, sandboxed Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity or OpenCode session as a peer consultant: it may read files and search and browse the web, but cannot edit files, change the system, start other agents, or start consultations of its own. Returns a structured answer -- findings with their grounds, alternatives, unknowns, what would change the judgement, and next checks.
